segments.text: Welcome everyone to our deep dive into modern artificial intelligence.
First let us review how gradient descent updates parameter weights.
A neural network consists of layers of interconnected artificial neurons.
Overfitting happens when the model memorizes noise in the training set.
Regularization techniques like dropout help prevent memorization.
When training a deep neural network, batch normalization stabilizes gradients.
Attention mechanisms allow models to focus on relevant context tokens.
Transformers revolutionized natural language processing across all benchmarks.
